text:
I need to verify if Paul Frees voiced Gomez Addams in the Hanna-Barbera animated series of The Addams Family.

Hanna-Barbera produced "The Addams Family" animated series in 1973. In this series, Gomez Addams was voiced by Lennie Weinrib, not Paul Frees. Paul Frees did voice work for many Hanna-Barbera productions, but he was not the voice of Gomez in The Addams Family cartoon.

Verdict: INCORRECT
